findings.io_uring_enter: RawRing release-publishes the SQ tail before calling the syscall; the syscall consumes already-published entries, it does not publish them.
findings.io_uring_queue_init: The designated reference-setup executable calls IoUring.init_params, not IoUring.init; the SDK dependency is init -> init_params, not the reverse. The cat tutorial directly calls init.
findings.io_uring_prep_fadvise: The reference checks a successful NORMAL-advice CQE. Subsequent file reads and anonymous-page zeroing cannot be attributed to FADVISE.
findings.io_uring_prep_madvise: The generic read/memory-effect scope needs the actual DONTNEED anonymous-page zeroing boundary.
findings.io_uring_prep_openat2: The generic read/memory-effect scope needs the actual descriptor/regular-file-prefix boundary.

red_contract: tests/test_reference_semantics.py records the defective generated bindings as-is. The correction flips the full-shape fixture in the next commit.
